jobs.title: Senior Product Growth Manager (B2B & B2G Strategy)
jobs.description:
**The Mission**  

  

We are looking for a strategic Growth Lead to drive our expansion into both high\-velocity B2B enterprise markets and high\-trust B2G (Government) sectors. You will bridge the gap between our product roadmap and the distinct procurement requirements of both domains. Your goal is to own the "land\-and\-expand" motion—turning initial pilots into mission\-critical partnerships by mastering the art of stakeholder diplomacy, compliance\-first architecture, and frictionless onboarding. **What You’ll Do*** **Dual\-Track Growth Strategy:** Architect and execute distinct growth motions for B2B (velocity, product\-led expansion) and B2G (high\-trust, pre\-tender engagement).
* **Compliance\-as\-a\-Growth\-Lever:** Partner with engineering/security to integrate rigorous standards (SOC2, FedRAMP, etc.) into the product experience, ensuring security becomes a competitive advantage that accelerates procurement sign\-off in both sectors.
* **Multi\-Stakeholder Orchestration:** Navigate complex buying committees. You will tailor value propositions that satisfy the technical needs of end\-users while addressing the risk\-mitigation and budgetary requirements of executive/procurement leadership.
* **Pilot\-to\-Enterprise Scaling:** Own the conversion of early\-stage pilots into enterprise\-wide deployments. Use product analytics to identify usage triggers that justify expansion.
* **Procurement Velocity:** Proactively manage the "red tape." Streamline the documentation, security attestations, and compliance workflows that slow down deal cycles in both B2B and public sector environments.

 **What We’re Looking For*** **Experience:** 6\+ years in Product, Growth, or Strategic Partnerships within B2B SaaS.
* **Sector Versatility:** Proven track record of managing enterprise\-level complexity. Experience with B2G/Public Sector procurement or highly regulated B2B industries (e.g., FinTech, HealthTech) is highly preferred.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Expert in product analytics; you don't just "guess" at growth—you use behavioral data to map the user journey from initial login to enterprise\-wide adoption.
* **Compliance Fluency:** Ability to communicate complex security/privacy postures to non\-technical stakeholders, building the trust required to win large\-scale accounts.
* **Consultative Mindset:** A history of influencing stakeholders before an RFP is issued or a formal contract is requested.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Insurance)
jobs.description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**



At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.



Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.



Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.


**Tide facts:**


* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**



Tide launched its first insurance products to market in 2025 in the UK and India. Insurance is a core SME need,and Tide is uniquely positioned to offer tailored and comprehensive cover to our members. Our Insurance team is relatively new and we are rapidly hiring to fill business\-critical roles and build a world\-class offering for our members.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**



As a Senior Product Manager, you'll shape the vision and roadmap for our insurance products, drive innovation and scale across markets. This is a high\-ownership role that blends strategic thinking, execution excellence, and cross\-functional leadership. You'll work closely with teams across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, and Compliance to create a world\-class insurance experience that meets the evolving needs of business owners globally.



You'll be working alongside experienced product professionals and hand\-in\-hand with senior developers, data scientists, designers, and marketers to launch new insurance products to market and continuously improve the performance and customer experience of our existing product suite.


* Own the vision and roadmap for key product domains within Insurance, driving innovation and global scale in collaboration with the Director of Product and leadership team.
* Design globally scalable solutions, balancing market nuances and regulatory complexity across Tide's key markets.
* Champion cross\-functional excellence by partnering with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and R\&C to ship impactful, high\-quality experiences.
* Lead discovery and experimentation, combining qualitative insights and quantitative data to identify opportunities, test hypotheses, and shape the product direction.
* Communicate with influence; clearly articulating strategy, priorities, and progress to senior stakeholders, inspiring alignment and confidence across the organisation.
* Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring member needs remain central to every decision, while advocating for simplicity, transparency, trust and regulatory compliance.
* Lead by example: you will be hands\-on, take ownership of business metrics and product KPIs and play a pivotal role in bringing all stakeholders on board.
* Continuously improve processes and practices within the product area to enable effective delivery by the teams.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**



This role is for you if you're a seasoned product professional with a deep understanding of user\-first product development, a hypothesis and data\-driven mindset, and a passion for iterative discovery and delivery.


* You have 4\-7 years of experience in product management, with hands\-on involvement throughout the full product development lifecycle, particularly in iterative product discovery and delivery.
* You have experience of the insurance market and launching products globally (ideally UK, India, Germany, France).
* You are both strategic and execution\-focused, with a proven ability to drive product improvements and deliver measurable results.
* You enjoy hands\-on product management and are excited to contribute to a team that's scaling, bringing your expertise to build great products.
* You naturally spot opportunities for improvement in processes, tools, or team workflows and can drive impactful changes with agility.
* You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and can break down greenfield areas into clear steps, milestones, and actionable plans while remaining flexible to adapt as needed.
* You are an excellent communicator, able to tailor your messaging to resonate across all levels, including senior leadership, and you are a compelling storyteller in both written and spoken English.
* You are outcome\-driven, focused on creating value for both users and the business, and can confidently pivot strategies to maintain alignment with goals.
* You are passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences, paying close attention to UX details and ensuring end\-to\-end solutions meet diverse consumer needs.
* You are analytical and data\-driven with a strong KPI focus; well versed in conversion metrics and quantitative and qualitative data.

 At this level, "Principal" signifies a person who serves as a primary architect of our product culture and strategy.  There are certain functions and capabilities we believe are essential to this internship:
   

  

* Strategy \& Vision: Translate our company mission into a multi\-year product roadmap that anticipates market shifts
* Organizational Strategy: Identify and bridge gaps between business goals and technical execution across multiple product domains

* Craft Excellence: Define and implement the "gold standard" for product discovery, delivery, and measurement across the organization

**What We Consider Relevant Qualifications, Experience And Knowledge**
 To succeed in this role and fast\-track toward an Associate position, you should bring:
   

  

* Experience: 10\+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Principal level within a fast\-scaling tech environment and a proven track record of delivering massive impact in high\-complexity environments

* Leadership \& Influence: Expert\-level stakeholder management skills; you can navigate conflicting priorities and drive consensus at the VP and C\-suite level


**Performance indicators to get you off to a great start**
 We don't expect you to know everything on Day 1, but we do expect you to grow fast. Here is how we will measure your success:
   

  

* Day 30: Conduct a "listening tour" across the organization and present an initial assessment of our current product gaps and opportunities

* Day 90: Successfully lead one major product release or framework improvement and begin mentoring at least one Senior PM on specific craft skills

jobs.description:
**Product Leader — Echo** 




*Reports to: Founder \| Engagement: Full\-time \| Location: Hyderabad* 




**Role overview** 




 Owns Echo product end\-to\-end: strategy, roadmap, design, and team build\-out. Partners closely with the Engineering Leader on feasibility and trade\-offs, and with the GTM Leader on customer signal and market positioning. This role is responsible for the product's trajectory from current early deployments through enterprise scale.
 



 Echo is an enterprise conversational BI platform that translates natural language to SQL over SAP and traditional data warehouse systems, with flexible deployment across cloud, private cloud, and fully on\-premise environments (including H100\-class GPU infrastructure for air\-gapped banking and healthcare deployments). The stack combines a fine\-tuned NL\-to\-SQL engine, a semantic layer for business term resolution, and a retrieval layer over schema and historical query patterns, with an evaluation harness for accuracy and hallucination control.
 



**Core responsibilities** 



* Product strategy: positioning, ICP definition, feature prioritization, and competitive differentiation
* Roadmap ownership: quarterly and annual planning, release sequencing, scope discipline
* Product specification: detailed PRDs, design partnership, acceptance criteria
* Customer discovery: structured engagement with active customers and prospects to validate direction
* Compliance and certification track ownership (SOC 2, ISO 27001, sector\-specific certifications as relevant)
* Product team build\-out across designers, PMs, and technical writers as scale demands



**Required experience** 



* 5\+ years in product management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
* Experience building enterprise B2B SaaS products, ideally in data, BI, or analytics
* Demonstrated ability to own a product from early stage through enterprise scale
* Customer\-facing product discovery experience: structured interviews, win/loss analysis, requirements synthesis
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade\-offs and feasibility



**Preferred experience** 



* Background with a data, BI, analytics, or developer tools SaaS vendor
* Familiarity with conversational AI, natural\-language interfaces, or LLM\-based products
* Experience with enterprise compliance certifications and procurement processes
* Domain depth in banking or healthcare

* Understanding Identity and Access Management at an Administrator level with the expertise and background of a Privileged Access Management enterprise application.
* Knowledge of automation experience leveraging Application Programming Interface (API) and provide key metrics for supported applications.

-----------------

 As a Principal Engineering Manager on the GitHub Developer Experience (DX) team, you will lead a team responsible for foundational systems and services that power GitHub’s internal engineering and development workflows. Our work spans CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, virtualized infrastructure, and the paved paths that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining reliability and security.


We provide the tooling, services, and operational support that allow engineers to deliver changes to production safely and efficiently. This includes running highly available, company\-wide CI platforms; partnering closely with application and platform teams to improve reliability and performance; and continuously reducing friction in the developer workflow. The team plays a critical role in maintaining trust in GitHub’s build and test infrastructure while balancing speed, scale, and stability.


GitHub’s continued growth brings both opportunity and complexity. As a Principal Engineering Manager in this role, you will lead a team operating mission\-critical systems in a fast\-moving environment. **Description**
 About the Organization
   

  

 Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business — retail, devices, digital products, business, and drivers. Our Associate Experience team owns the product strategy, tooling, and AI systems that define how Customer Service agents work: what information they can access, what actions they can take, and how effectively they resolve customer issues on first contact.
   

  

 At the center of this is our associate\-facing customer service platform — the primary interface through which agents across the globe handle customer contacts across chat, email, phone, and messaging channels. We are investing in rebuilding this platform for the AI era: moving from rigid, domain\-specific workflows toward a flexible, intelligent experience where AI and human agents work side by side to deliver faster, more consistent, and higher\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Product Management Tech to own the product strategy and execution for our associate platform across four high\-volume, high\-complexity contact domains.
   

  

 This leader will define and deliver the agent\-facing experience for these domains — reducing friction in how associates work, eliminating inconsistency in how issues are resolved, and building an AI\-native UI that surfaces the right context, guidance, and resolution options to agents in real time. The north star is simple: every customer contact in these domains ends with a fast, consistent, on\-brand resolution on first contact, demonstrating the very best of human and AI collaboration.
   

  

 The current product does not exist in the form it needs to be. This leader will contribute to the overall platform vision, build the team around the key domains, set the roadmap, and drive execution — partnering closely with the customer\-facing product teams that own the same domains on the customer self\-service side, and with engineering, data science, and customer service operations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for the associate platform across different businesses — from problem definition and strategy through requirements, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Build on an AI\-native agent experience. Design and deliver resolutions embedded in an AI\-led UI— surfacing relevant customer context and recommending resolution paths in real time— so that associates spend their time on attending to the customer, not managing the tool. Measure success through first contact resolution rates, handle time, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive workflow simplification. Eliminate the specialized tooling and routing dependencies that require associates to be trained on narrow issue types. Build upon the product model that enables associates to handle contacts across domains flexibly, without sacrificing resolution quality.
* Build the team. Hire and develop individual product managers for each domain, create clear ownership structures, establish product development processes, and build a high\-performing PM team that operates ahead of engineering — not behind it.
* Partner cross\-functionally. Work directly with the customer\-facing product teams that own the consumer experience for these same domains to ensure agent tooling reflects and enables the customer experience being built. Partner with engineering, data and applied sciences, BI, UX, and customer service operations on roadmap sequencing, launch planning, and adoption.
* Deliver a key 2026 strategic initiative that supports a senior leadership commitment, requiring tight cross\-functional coordination and on\-time delivery.
* Represent your product portfolio in senior leadership reviews and planning cycles, authoring clear, data\-backed product strategy documents and investment narratives.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* 3\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems

 We are seeking a visionary and highly experienced
 **Director, CashIn‑ Engineering Partner** 
 to lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and transformation for all cashin/Order to Cash‑ processes across the Group. This role will own the engineering agenda across complex billing, rating, charging, and invoicing platforms—driving the next generation of our billing landscape while ensuring operational excellence today.

* Strong capability to define roadmaps, manage budgets, and influence senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior People Ops Manager - Product Optimization
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 People Operations continues to evolve its operating model to drive scale, quality, and efficiency through structured Continuous Improvement (CI), Lean, and Six Sigma practices, augmented by automation and AI where appropriate. This role serves as a senior individual contributor responsible for orchestrating CI programs, ensuring disciplined intake, prioritization, execution governance, and measurable value delivery.
   

  

 The role is centered on process excellence and CI program management—owning the mechanisms that convert operational problems into clearly defined improvement initiatives, tracking them through execution, and ensuring benefits realization. While the role partners closely with automation and AI solution teams, its primary accountability is process design, CI rigor, and execution flow.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Continuous Improvement (CI) Program Ownership**
* Own and operate the CI intake model, ensuring ideas are consistently assessed using Lean and Six Sigma principles (problem clarity, root cause, value, feasibility).
* Translate intake requests into well‑formed CI charters with defined scope, problem statements, baseline metrics, target state, benefits, risks, and dependencies.
* Ensure CI efforts focus on cycle time reduction, waste elimination, defect reduction, standardization, and flow efficiency. Manage the CI delivery cadence, ensuring initiatives progress predictably from intake through implementation and benefit realization.


**Lean \& Six Sigma Application**
* Apply Lean methodologies (value stream mapping, waste identification, handoff reduction, flow optimization) to diagnose and improve end‑to‑end processes.
* Apply Six Sigma techniques (root cause analysis, variation reduction, control mechanisms) to address recurring defects and quality issues.
* Ensure improvements are designed into the process, not reliant on individual behavior or workarounds.
* Support establishment of process controls, KPIs, and monitoring mechanisms to sustain gains.


**Backlog, Governance \& Execution Discipline**
* Own and maintain the ADO backlog, ensuring CI work items are properly scoped, prioritized, tracked, and documented.
* Support security, privacy, and compliance reviews by ensuring CI initiatives have complete artifacts and meet governance entry criteria.
* Track dependencies, risks, and constraints across CI, operations, platform, and policy stakeholders.
* Maintain strong operational hygiene—clear decision logs, status transparency, and audit‑ready documentation.


**Reporting \& Insights**
* Own CI program reporting, providing visibility into throughput, aging, risks, blocked items, and delivered value.
* Produce structured insights that highlight systemic bottlenecks, recurring failure points, and improvement themes.
* Enable leadership visibility into CI health without taking on performance or people management responsibilities.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with operations, COEs, automation teams, engineering, and governance functions to keep CI initiatives unblocked.
* Act as the coordination point between problem identification, CI design, and execution.
* Influence outcomes through data, structure, and CI rigor.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources (HR), Business, or related field AND 7\+ years experience in process improvement, continuous improvement, operations excellence, or program execution roles.
+ OR Master's Degree in Human Resources (HR), Business, Operations or related field AND 5\+ years experience in process improvement, continuous improvement, operations excellence, or program execution roles.
+ OR equivalent experience.

* Proven ability to manage CI intake, charters, backlogs, dependencies, and delivery cadence.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into structured improvement initiatives.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong hands‑on experience applying Lean and/or Six Sigma methodologies in operational environments. Ideally with formal Lean / Six Sigma certification (Black Belt).
* Experience in Program or Project Management, particularly for transformation or CI initiatives.
* Experience in low code/no code development, alongside exposure to automation or AI‑enabled process redesign \-\- without requirement for citizen development or solution engineering ownership.
* Familiarity with ADO or similar work‑tracking systems.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders in complex, compliance‑sensitive environments.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

jobs.title: Data Analyst 2
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Positions in this family are related to the manipulation and analysis of data in support of a variety of analytic solutions. Roles within the family work with vast amounts of data from multiple sources, including administrative claims data provided by payers and electronic medical record (EMR) data provided by providers, to develop predictive and prescriptive analytics to the enterprise.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


Positions in this function are responsible for the management and manipulation of mostly structured data, with a focus on building business intelligence tools, conducting analysis to distinguish patterns and recognize trends, performing normalization operations and assuring data quality.


Depending on the specific role and business line, responsibilities in this function could include:

* Clinical Code Mapping \& Normalization
	+ Analyze local, proprietary, or EMR specific codes and map them to standard vocabularies such diagnosis codes, medication codes, lab codes, and other clinical concepts
	+ Define and maintaining crosswalks between source EMR codes and standard terminologies, including handling one to many and many to one mappings
	+ Apply clinical and coding knowledge to resolve ambiguous, deprecated, or conflicting codes
	+ Support normalization of lab test result, lab test unit, medication route of administration, medication unit and medication dosage form values
	+ Support the evolution of mapping and normalization approaches toward ontology\-based semantic modeling, including aligning codes to standardized clinical concepts, hierarchies, and relationships to enable more scalable and reusable analytic logic
* Requirements \& Specification Development
	+ Elicit and document business and data requirements for code standardization and normalization processes

We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.
The Opportunity:

A highly motivated and experienced Scheduler/ Project control specialist to support risk management team in developing comprehensive QRA reports for complex construction projects. Understands Project control and risk assessment methodologies used within the construction industry, cost and schedule risk analysis, and unique challenges. Provide hands on support to APAC construction projects by keeping the Omega 365 project risk register current and accurate, and enabling cross functional collaboration on risk updates and reporting. **In this role you will:*** Monitor, analyse and control the project performance and risk on complex projects.
* Oversee project risk, analyse the risk impact on Project cost \& timeline for early mitigation plan.
* Understands risk assessment methodologies used within the construction industry, cost and schedule risk analysis.
* Maintain and update project risk registers in Omega: add/edit risks, reflect status/probability/impact changes, and ensure records are complete and current
* Liaise with Construction PMs to capture new risks, confirm changes, and document mitigation actions and owners in the register.
* Liaise with Planning and Cost managers to capture new risks, confirm changes, and document mitigation actions and owners in the register.
* Coordinate with Cost and Planning to align risk records with cost and schedule impact inputs and changes.
* Attend and Facilitate risk register reviews and working sessions to drive timely updates and closure of actions
* Perform data quality checks (missing/duplicate/conflicting entries, mitigation completeness) and issue basic quality/status follow ups  


	+ Track risk mitigation actions to ensure these are completed in line with the proposed timescales.
	+ Maintenance of the internal risk breakdown structure linked database.
	+ Develop risk management reports.
	+ Supporting the knowledge sharing of risks and opportunities across the portfolio of projects ensuring that lessons are learnt.

 **We would love to hear from you if:*** You have experience as a risk analyst in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Have 8\+ years of experience in project control, scheduling or project risk management with hands on experience in Primavera P6]
* Ideally have professional certifications in risk management (e.g., PMI\-RMP, IRM\-Cert, etc)
* Are knowledgable in Safran, Primavera OPC, @risk, MS Project, Power BI an added advantage.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, problem\-solving, and IT skill.
* You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.
* You strive to work in a team supporting clients on complex, large\-scale construction projects
* Experience with data analysis tools and risk management software
* Knowledge of construction methodologies, regulations, and best practices.
* You enjoy staying abreast of industry best practices and regulatory requirements related to risk management in the construction sectors.
* Are able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrate innovative thinking and fast to adapt new developments in the market.
* Can handle multiple projects and stakeholders from various time zones.
* Are eager to learn new skills and knowledge for personal and business need.

**Role Overview**

As a Relationship Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging, nurturing, and onboarding brands onto the frantiger® platform.

This is a consultative sales role that combines business development, relationship management, inside sales, and account management.

You will work directly with founders, business owners, franchise heads, and expansion managers.

If you enjoy speaking with people, understanding business models, solving problems, and closing deals, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

Brand Acquisition \& Business Development

* Identify and approach franchise brands, distributors, manufacturers, and business owners.
* Generate qualified leads through calls, emails, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and referrals.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand business requirements.
* Present frantiger® solutions and platform capabilities.
* Schedule and coordinate meetings with decision\-makers.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

**Relationship Management**

* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Become a trusted point of contact for brands.
* Follow up consistently and professionally.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding.

**Platform Onboarding**

* Assist brands in creating and publishing business opportunity listings.
* Collect required business information and documentation.
* Guide brands through platform workflows and verification processes.
* Support adoption of frantiger® products and services.

**CRM \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records in CRM.
* Track lead stages and sales activities.
* Submit weekly pipeline and performance reports.
* Ensure follow\-ups are never missed.

**Ideal Candidate Profile Required**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in sales, business development, inside sales, relationship management, or account management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong phone etiquette and presentation skills.
* Comfortable speaking with founders, CXOs, and business owners.
* Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Self\-driven and target\-oriented.

**Preferred**

* Experience in franchise sales, B2B sales, SaaS sales, consulting, recruitment, insurance, banking, real estate, or business services.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms.
* Understanding of franchise and business expansion models.
* Experience handling high\-value transactions or consultative sales.

Success Metrics

You will be evaluated on:

* Qualified leads generated
* Discovery calls conducted
* Brand meetings scheduled
* Listings onboarded
* Revenue generated
* CRM discipline and reporting accuracy
* Client satisfaction and relationship quality

What We Are Looking For

We value:

* Ownership mindset
* Strong communication
* Consistency
* Integrity
* Curiosity
* Problem\-solving ability
* Hunger to grow professionally

We do not believe in micromanagement. We believe in accountability and outcomes.

Compensation

* Fixed Salary
* Attractive Performance Incentives
* Growth Opportunities
* Direct Exposure to Founders
* Opportunity to work on a high\-growth business platform

High performers will have opportunities to take on larger responsibilities and leadership roles as frantiger® scales.

Why Join frantiger®

* Build relationships with business owners across industries.
* Work directly with founders and decision\-makers.
* Gain exposure to franchising, investments, business consulting, and technology.
* Be part of a company building the future of franchise growth and business participation.

Pay: ₹18,304\.40 \- ₹72,760\.75 per month

jobs.description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Staff Software Engineer \- IOS, Player Team \- Bangalore**  

  

**About Warner Bros. Discovery:**  

Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.  

  

For more information, please visit www.wbd.com  

  

**Meet Our Team:**  

We are the Product Engineering group for Direct\-2\-Consumer business, and responsible for building OTT Player (HLS and DASH) for several Warner Bros Discovery products across 70\+ different platforms. We build Player SDK for Android, Apple, Desktop, HWA and STB platforms to provide seamless integration experience to the WBD applications.  

  

The ideal candidate has a track record of having built multiple high\-performance, stable, scalable Apple applications, Swift tech stack, HLS / DASH Players and expertise in Software Architecture / Design principles. You choose the right architecture and design patterns for solving the business problems. You own the quality of the Software product. You are customer obsessed and always challenge yourself to provide the best quality playback experience to the WBD users. You are a team player and collaborate with peers and mentor SDEs. You are self\-critical about your work and our product and have a continuous improvement mindset. You help your SDM in grooming the backlog and estimations. You are obsessed about Operational Excellence and always strive for engineering excellence. You show good judgment making trade\-offs between immediate and long\-term business needs  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Build product features in close collaboration with TPM, SDM and product stakeholders.
* Advocate best practices for Player Architecture, Design \& Development.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders in architecting, designing and developing the Player SDK.
* Own all aspects of the product development from concept, and drive it through development, testing, acceptance, adoption and iterative changes
* Sheer focus on Operational excellence and metrics driven.
* Focus on Engineering excellence, keep tab on Architecture / Design trends, Always look out for improvement scopes, keep tab on Protocol spec \& suggest new features.
* Be Self Critical about your work and obsessed about continuous improvement.
* Customer Obsession \- Anyone who uses Player SDK is your customer, always respond positively to your internal customers (Testers, Client App Developers, Product Managers, etc) \& be receptive to feedback, be obsessed to improve playback experience for end users

**What to Bring:**

* 9\-12 years’ experience in Broadcasting Video / OTT domain and architecting native applications for Apple ecosystem
* Sound understanding of Apple/TV Architecture, Media Framework, Media Player APIs, AV Foundation API, Apple SDK, Swift, Debugger
* Data driven technical decision\-making skills for architecture and design of new product features.
* Eye to details and identify optimization scope for performance improvements.
* Experience in DevOps/SRE practices such as CI/CD, performance monitoring \& incident management
* Mentoring, Coaching skills to build the succession for architecture and design.
* Good understanding of the basic components of Android: Activity, Services, Intent, Broadcast Receiver, Content Provider, UI components \& controls.
* Familiar with Web Service Integration (REST, JSON) and REST concepts
* Strong computer Science fundamentals in object\-oriented design, algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis.
* Good verbal \& written communication skills

 **What We Offer:**

* A Great Place to work
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**




 You have personally shipped a consumer financial product to real users — and you can name the line of code, the policy clause, or the CS conversation that broke things and what you did about it. Not "led a team that shipped." Not "owned the roadmap." You wrote the spec, you sat in CS calls, you queried the data yourself, you watched the dashboards on launch night.
 



  





 That is the qualifying condition for this role. Everything else in this document is for people who pass that bar. If you do not pass it, no amount of brand\-name PMs on your resume, MBA pedigree, or strategy deck experience makes up for it. We will know within ten minutes of an interview. Save us both the time.
 



 If you do pass it, this is the role you have been waiting for.
 



  





**The bet**




 Every fintech in India is shipping the same feature set: savings, cards, investments, wrap\-around banking. We are betting that the company that ships them with the most opinionated taste — fewer screens, fewer settings, fewer apologies — owns the next decade of consumer finance in India. That bet runs through every PM here.
 



  





 You will own a consumer\-facing surface end to end. Roadmap, specs, design partnership, engineering partnership, CS feedback loops, compliance review, launch operation, post\-launch retention. You will not have a strategy team. You will not have a research team. You will not have a launch ops team. You will be all of those things.
 



  





**The team you'll work with — small, young, fast, default\-AI**




 Most of the people you will work with are in their twenties or early thirties. The defaults are "build it yourself, ship it tonight, fix it tomorrow." Meetings are short. Documents are shorter.
 



 The right hire treats this as a feature, not a compromise. You will be one PM among a handful, owning a meaningful surface. You will move at the engineering team's pace, not slower. You will earn their respect by writing the SQL alongside them, not by holding alignment reviews.
 



  





 If you have spent the last three years building scaffolding around yourself — PgM partners, ops partners, strategy partners, BI partners — you will struggle here. If the thought of doing your own data pull at 11pm to settle a launch question makes you happy, read on.
 



  





**What makes this different from the same title anywhere else**




 The surface is the company, not a screen. Most PM roles at this band own a flow. You will own a value\-prop. The decision on whether we launch a feature on a regulated entity vs. a PPI rail goes through you.
 



  





 You will use AI as a first\-class teammate, not as a feature to add. The spec you write, the CS analysis you do, the user research you run, the launch comms you draft — they all use models. You won't get points for "leveraging AI." You will lose points for not.
 



  





 It is regulated infrastructure, and that is a feature. Two RBI\-licensed entities sit underneath the surface. Most of your launches will pass through a compliance review you will sit in. The moat that comes with doing it right is real.
 



  





 You will work next to peers who match your bar. The Director of Product (AI), the Director of Engineering (AI), and the founding PMs all hire to this same filter.
 



  





**What you'll own**




 The end\-to\-end PRD. Customer problem statement, the chosen segment, the named alternative we will not build, the metric we will move, the kill criteria. Written in markdown, not Confluence. No longer than two pages.
 



  





 The launch decision. Whether we ship, whether we delay, whether we kill. You will own the data pull that supports the call. You will own the conversation with the founder when the data disagrees with the plan.
 



  





 The CS feedback loop. You will read CS tickets for your surface daily. You will sit on a CS call weekly. You will know the top three reasons users complain about your feature within a week of launch. You will turn at least one of them into a shipped fix within two weeks.
 



  





 The compliance partnership. You will sit in the compliance review for every regulated decision. You will know what RBI, NBFC, PPI, and DPDP each constrain and where they intersect. You will not delegate this to a compliance partner who walks into the meeting cold.
 



  





 The taste call. You will be the final arbiter of one specific screen, one specific copy line, one specific entry point. When engineering disagrees, you will hold it. When design disagrees, you will hold it. When you are wrong, you will admit it within a week and ship the fix.
 



  





**What we're looking for, beyond the qualifying filter**




 Operator instincts. When something is wrong with a launch, you read the events, write the SQL, talk to the user, file the bug. You do not "ask the team to look into it."
 



 Range across products. You will not own one surface for years. As Jupiter moves, your remit will too — savings one quarter, cards the next, payments the one after. If you need 18 months to "really understand a domain" before you can contribute, this is not a match. You are at home in week three on a new product because you read the events, talked to ten users, and shipped a small fix. This one is non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Fintech experience is a tailwind, not a requirement. If you have shipped consumer products in another domain — health, ed\-tech, gaming, commerce — the qualifying filter and the operator instincts matter more than the category. The compliance literacy is teachable in the first 90 days; the operator instincts are not.
 



  





 Spec discipline. Your specs are short, specific, and falsifiable. You name the metric, the threshold, and the kill criteria upfront. You do not write "drive engagement." Default\-AI fluency. You can write a Cursor or Claude agent prompt that pulls a product question from the team Slack and answers it from the metrics war…

 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand, with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 Our Mass Customization Platform, or MCP, is a modular, multi\-tenant platform used by Cimpress businesses including Vistaprint, Pixartprinting, Tradeprint, Drukwerkdeal, National Pen, and others. MCP enables our businesses to create, configure, sell, manufacture, and fulfill a vast range of customizable products across global markets.
 



  





**About the Product Catalog Domain**




 The Product Catalog Domain owns the central product information and product modeling capabilities used across Cimpress businesses. Our core product, the MCP PIM, is much more than a traditional Product Information Management system. * 5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Product Management or Product Operations experience in online commerce, with a practical understanding of the mobile gaming lifecycle.
* Gaming expertise, strategic product/engineering collaboration, and the ability to navigate ambiguity for a user\-facing product.


**About the job** 
 In this role, you will support the development and execution of the Play Store Product roadmap; specifically regarding game quality across search, discovery, and emerging surfaces. You will define, operationalize, and scale guidelines and frameworks for game classification, qualitative evaluation, and deployment to help partner teams connect users to highly relevant, high quality games. You will ensure all details for a new feature to go live are flawlessly executed, from initial design to final operations processes. This includes driving communications, testing/piloting, launch activities, training, addressing bugs and ongoing operational support. You will also track progress on new feature development, clearly communicating milestones, feature details, and launches with cross\-functional stakeholders and build relationships with games stakeholders, establishing open channels of communication for feedback, product suggestions and escalations. You will implement and manage product development and operationalization frameworks to work with new Large Language Model (LLM) technologies and will support prompt and context engineering efforts and human computation operations (HITL) to scale game quality evaluations.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
   

  

 To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

* Support the development and execution of the Play Store Product roadmap, specifically regarding game quality across search, discovery, and emerging surfaces.
* Define, operationalize, and scale guidelines and frameworks for game classification, qualitative evaluation, and deployment to help partner teams connect users to highly relevant, high quality games.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer (HRSD)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We are looking for a Jr. ServiceNow HRSD Developer to join FME's Enterprise Tools team and support our HRSD implementation alongside the HRSD Team. This is a hands\-on development and configuration role where you will contribute to building and testing HRSD capabilities, assist with data migration and integration support tasks, and help maintain platform quality through the sprint cycles and UAT. Post\-implementation.


Fresenius Medical Care is a global leader in renal care products and services, dedicated to improving patient quality of life. Our Enterprise Tools team owns the ServiceNow platform and is undertaking a major HRSD implementation to replace the legacy Dovetail case management system with a modern, scalable, employee\-centric HR service delivery platform.


The HRSD program covers: Case Management, Employee Relations, Employee Center Pro, HR Agent Workspace, Employee Document Management (replacing PeopleDoc and OnBase), Knowledge Management (with SharePoint external source), Universal Requests, Workday HCM integration, Internationalization (3 languages), Dynamic Translations, Data Migration from Dovetail, and OCM.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HRSD****Capabilties**

* Execute assigned configuration and development tasks within HRSD modules — Case Management, Employee Relations, Employee Center Pro, HR Agent Workspace, EDM, Knowledge Management, and Universal Requests — under Sr. Developer direction.
* Assist with Case Management configuration: Topic Categories, Topic Details, Templates, Assignment Rules, SLAs, custom fields, form/list layouts, and standard Notifications.
* Support Employee Center Pro configuration: portal record setup, widget layout, audience configuration, taxonomy, and content creation (banners, announcements, quick links, calendar schedules).
* Assist HR Agent Workspace configuration: workspace list setup, form layout adjustments, and branding alignment with EC portal.
* Support Employee Document Management: Document Type and Security Policy configuration, Advanced Forms template builds (low/medium complexity), and Bulk Import staging and validation.
* Assist with Knowledge Management: Knowledge Base and Category setup, workflow configuration, article import, and SharePoint external source configuration under Sr. guidance.
* Contribute to Universal Requests configuration: Service Set, Assignment Groups, Service Configurations, State Mappings, and Record Producer build.
* Support Internationalization: assist with localization property setup, field/label export preparation, and import of translated values.
* Build Flow Designer flows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, and UI Policies for assigned user stories; submit for Sr. Developer code review before promotion.
**Testing, Migration \& Quality**

* Execute unit testing on all assigned configurations and document results against sprint acceptance criteria.
* Assist in building and running ATF test scripts for HRSD configurations.
* Support data migration activities: assist with Dovetail case migration template validation, field mapping review, and import staging/validation under Sr. Developer oversight.
* Assist with EDM Bulk Document Import staging: validate file sizes, naming conventions, and metadata from PeopleDoc and OnBase source systems.
* Log, track, and retest defects during UAT cycles; assist Sr. Developer with defect remediation tasks.
* Maintain configuration documentation, sprint notes, and technical runbook updates.
**Collaboration**

* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team contributor.
* Respond to support requests from HR process owners and platform users; escalate to Sr. Developer as needed.
* Assist with update set preparation and environment promotions (Dev Test Prod)
* Actively apply feedback from code reviews and seek opportunities to deepen HRSD platform expertise.
 **Required Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of ServiceNow development or administration experience in an enterprise environment.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer basics.
* Exposure to HRSD or HR Service Management within ServiceNow — coursework, certification, or hands\-on experience.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow portal/Employee Center configuration (Service Portal or EC Pro).
* Understanding of ServiceNow role\-based access control (ACLs, User Criteria, groups).
* Experience working within Agile or sprint\-based delivery teams.
* Ability to execute well\-defined configuration tasks from functional specifications with minimal rework.
* Detail\-oriented; comfortable with documentation requirements and sprint\-based deliverable tracking.
* Collaborative, growth\-oriented mindset; receptive to mentorship and code review feedback.
 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands\-on experience with any HRSD module: Case Management, Employee Center, HR Agent Workspace, or EDM.
* Experience with Knowledge Management configuration — Knowledge Bases, workflows, article imports.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow transform maps, import sets, or data migration tooling.
* Exposure to Workday or other HCM integrations in ServiceNow.
* Experience with ServiceNow Internationalization features (language plugins, label translation).
* Healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industry background is a plus.
* Familiarity with GDPR / data privacy requirements in an HR context.
 **Certifications**


Certified ServiceNow Administrator (CSA) \-**Required**


Certified Application Developer (CAD) \-**Preferred**


CIS — HR Service Delivery (HRSD) \-**Preferred**


Micro\-Cert — Employee Center Pro \-**Preferred**


Micro\-Cert — Agile and Test Management \-**Preferred**


ITIL 4 Foundation \-**Nice to Have**

We’re hiring a Product Manager to drive product execution across high\-impact initiatives at Earnifi.
 





 This is not a coordination role. We value PMs who create momentum, not just process. We’re looking for someone who can independently drive ambiguous work forward, align stakeholders, make thoughtful product decisions, and execute with urgency and ownership.
 





 The right person will combine strong product instincts with operational rigor. They should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and moving projects from idea to launch. 
 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own end\-to\-end product execution across key initiatives
* Drive projects forward independently and proactively remove blockers
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering, design, operations, leadership, and external stakeholders
* Gather input from stakeholders, synthesize differing viewpoints, and drive alignment toward decisions
* Translate business goals and user needs into clear product requirements and priorities
* Make high\-quality product decisions grounded in user empathy, data, and sound judgment
* Partner closely with leadership while operating with clear ownership over your product area
* Ensure teams stay focused, accountable, and moving with urgency
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and follow\-through
* Identify gaps, risks, and edge cases before they become problems
* Maintain a high bar for product quality and user experience



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer or fintech products
* Strong track record of shipping products and driving execution in fast\-moving environments
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to build consensus without escalating every decision
* Strong product sense and user empathy
* High ownership mentality — you naturally take initiative rather than wait for direction
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists
* Detail\-oriented with strong operational follow\-through
* Strong prioritization and decision\-making skills
* Able to challenge assumptions thoughtfully and advocate for users
* Experience working closely with engineering teams and managing tradeoffs effectively



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Projects move forward consistently without needing heavy oversight
* Stakeholders stay aligned and informed
* Product decisions reflect strong user understanding and sound judgment
* Teams execute efficiently with clear priorities and accountability
* Problems are identified early and addressed proactively
* Leadership can trust that important initiatives are being driven effectively



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in fintech, consumer products, or growth\-stage startups
* Experience working with distributed/global teams
* Strong analytical and data\-informed decision making
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled products and workflows



  





**Location** 





 Bangalore, India (on\-site)
 




  





**Company Description** 




 Earnifi addresses the gap between when people earn money and when they receive it, focusing on critical moments such as rent payments, bills, and cash flow challenges. The platform empowers users to access their earned wages without relying on credit, interest, or hidden fees, offering a transparent and debt\-free solution. As a VC\-backed startup, Earnifi has grown rapidly, achieving recognition as the \#1 paid finance app in the U.S. App Store. We value hands\-on collaboration in a fast\-paced environment and encourage team members to take ownership beyond their roles. If you thrive in an agile setting and enjoy seeing your work have an immediate impact, you'll thrive at Earnifi.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi\-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.



At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.


**Life @ Skillz**


* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes coverage for medical expenses for both you and your entire family. Additionally, take advantage of tax benefit options (PF \& NPS), expense reimbursement, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. We offer competitive paid time off (PL \& sick/casual) \& company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.

  


**Why Skillz?**


* Pioneers of Skill\-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill\-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T\-Mobile, Buzztime, Bowlero, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

  


**The Future of Gaming Awaits!**



The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest\-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025\. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.


**Job Description:**



As a Senior BI Analyst at Skillz, you will play a key role in building a trusted data ecosystem, driving analytical insights, and enabling data\-backed decision\-making. You'll partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver clear, actionable insights, streamline reporting, and develop scalable data models that influence business outcomes.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Align dashboards with updated logic and definitions; ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting.
* Provide weekly KPI commentary and explain business performance trends to stakeholders.
* Audit, consolidate, and streamline dashboards to improve reliability and reduce redundancy.
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses to uncover insights that drive measurable business impact.
* Build reusable Snowflake models and automate key dashboards and business review reports.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify performance drivers and share actionable recommendations.


**Requirements:**


* 3\+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data strategy roles.
* Proficiency in SQL and Tableau; experience with Snowflake or Python preferred.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, dashboard design, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear insights and business narratives.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with a focus on driving outcomes.
* Experience or passion for the gaming industry preferred.
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or related fields (preferred, not required).

  


**Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!**



Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. Join our team and be part of the journey. We look forward to having you on board!

  





Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance*.*

Join the **Data Analytics (DA)** team at **TII** across domains such as **Marketing and Digital, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Logistics, Store Operations, Finance** and more**.** Here you'll collaborate with business leaders to turn data into insights that drive strategic decisions. This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting\-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  

  

Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data \& Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data\-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. analytics, AI, and retail decision science
